//! Writes a database whose table names a column after the row identity,
//! which builds from before the name was reserved let a table do
use stoolap::Database;

fn main() {
    let out = std::env::args().nth(1).expect("an output directory");
    let db = Database::open(&format!("file://{out}")).unwrap();
    db.execute("CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, _rowid_ INTEGER)", ()).unwrap();
    db.execute("INSERT INTO t VALUES (1, 10), (2, 20)", ()).unwrap();
    db.close().unwrap();
}
